gaps.sentence: The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.
run out OF something = have none left.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: He ended ___ selling insurance, though he'd trained as a chef.
gaps.explanation: end up = finally be in a place/situation/state.

gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.
